description: GUCs applied with gpconfig to a Greenplum-family cluster, one list per role.

fields.description: Memory one segment instance (or the coordinator) may use for all its queries; the server cancels the biggest query above it. Engine default 8192, which caps a big host unless raised.
fields.name: gp_vmem_protect_limit
fields.title: Segment memory limit

fields.description: Upper bound of statement_mem for any session. Engine default 2000; statement_mem must stay below it, so it is written first.
fields.name: max_statement_mem
fields.title: Max statement memory

fields.description: Memory one query may use on one segment before operators spill to disk. Engine default 125; must be below max_statement_mem.
fields.name: statement_mem
fields.title: Statement memory

fields.description: Memory of one sort or hash step before it spills (engine default 32).
fields.name: work_mem
fields.title: Work memory

fields.description: Shared buffer pool of each segment instance (engine default 125). Analytic scans barely use it.
fields.name: shared_buffers
fields.title: Shared buffers

fields.description: The PostgreSQL planner's guess of the cache one segment instance can count on; GPORCA does not read it.
fields.name: effective_cache_size
fields.title: Effective cache size

fields.description: Share of gp_vmem_protect_limit above which the server starts cancelling the biggest queries (engine default 90).
fields.name: runaway_detector_activation_percent
fields.title: Runaway detector threshold

fields.description: How concurrency and memory of queries are managed: queue = resource queues (all engines), group = cgroups (needs a cgroup setup the images do not have), none = no manager (7.x and Cloudberry).
fields.name: gp_resource_manager
fields.title: Resource manager

fields.description: on = GPORCA plans queries, off = the PostgreSQL-based planner. The optimizer parameter of the database sets it.
fields.name: optimizer
fields.title: GPORCA

fields.description: When a statement triggers ANALYZE on its own: none, on_change or on_no_stats. 6.x engines default to on_no_stats, 7.x and Cloudberry to none.
fields.name: gp_autostats_mode
fields.title: Automatic statistics

fields.description: Background vacuum and analyze of the catalogs.
fields.name: autovacuum
fields.title: Autovacuum

fields.description: Transport of motion data between segments: udpifc (every engine's default), tcp or proxy.
fields.name: gp_interconnect_type
fields.title: Interconnect type

fields.description: Largest UDP packet of the interconnect (engine default 8192, which assumes jumbo frames). 1420 fits a 1500-byte MTU without IP fragmentation.
fields.name: gp_max_packet_size
fields.title: Interconnect packet size

fields.description: Packets a receiver queues per sender (engine default 4).
fields.name: gp_interconnect_queue_depth
fields.title: Receive queue depth

fields.description: Packets a sender keeps in flight per receiver (engine default 2).
fields.name: gp_interconnect_snd_queue_depth
fields.title: Send queue depth

fields.description: Client connections of the coordinator; on segments every session of the coordinator opens one connection per slice, so segments need at least 3 times the coordinator's value.
fields.name: max_connections
fields.title: Connections

fields.description: How long the fault prober waits for a segment to answer (engine default 20).
fields.name: gp_fts_probe_timeout
fields.title: FTS probe timeout

fields.description: Time between probes of all segments (engine default 60).
fields.name: gp_fts_probe_interval
fields.title: FTS probe interval

fields.description: How long the coordinator waits for a segment to accept a connection (engine default 180).
fields.name: gp_segment_connect_timeout
fields.title: Segment connect timeout

fields.description: WAL size that triggers a checkpoint. PostgreSQL 12 and 14 bases only (7.x, 8.x and Cloudberry).
fields.name: max_wal_size
fields.title: Max WAL size

fields.description: Raw `key = value` settings appended verbatim at the end of the file; keys must match ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*$. Entry order is not preserved.
fields.name: custom
fields.title: Extra settings

fields.description: The `custom` map joined into config lines; the template prints it at the end of the file.
fields.name: custom_rendered
fields.title: Rendered extra settings
